position: A retrieval service is useful only when its boundary is narrow: return candidates, evidence, confidence, and refusal signals.
headline: Retrieval should be a calm evidence finder.
copy: This gate keeps the service small enough to test. It may fetch and rank reviewed records; it may not become a hidden oracle.

postures.title: Allowed
postures.copy: Return source candidates, match reasons, trace id, confidence, and no-source status.

postures.title: Blocked
postures.copy: Do not create answer prose, store private user text, or make spiritual/ritual claims.

postures.title: Review
postures.copy: Route hold records, mantra records, and rights gaps to reviewer queues before display.

flow.title: Receive query
flow.copy: Normalize the learner question without changing its intent.

flow.title: Rank candidates
flow.copy: Use reviewed source records and show why each candidate matched.

flow.title: Return boundary
flow.copy: Send status, confidence, reviewer state, and no-source behavior to the adapter.

flow.title: Stay quiet
flow.copy: Leave answer writing to the bounded answer adapter.

decisions.label: Answer prose
decisions.reason: The adapter must compose with boundaries.

decisions.label: Reviewer override
decisions.reason: Human review state cannot be silently changed.

decisions.label: Private storage
decisions.reason: No account or consent system exists yet.

locks.title: No hidden generation
locks.copy: Retrieval cannot fill gaps with imagined scripture.

locks.title: No private profile
locks.copy: The prototype does not persist personal learner text beyond local demos.

locks.title: No launch authority
locks.copy: Service design does not imply public launch readiness.
